name: mstack-codex-led-review
description: Codex coordinator workflow for delivering a plan folder, a list of issues, or one larger task in a repository: Codex leads and its writer lanes edit in isolated worktrees (or one branch in Single mode), tracks each item as Open, In progress or Closed, gets read-only review from the other installed vendor that mstack-vendors offers (claude, or a fallback review), integrates, and delivers one pull request with serialized CI. Runs in Codex only.

interface.shortDescription: Deliver issues, a plan or a task with Codex lanes and review through mstack-vendors.
interface.longDescription: Codex leads and its writer lanes implement in isolated git worktrees (or one branch in Single mode), keeping an Open, In progress, Closed status table, getting read-only review from the other installed vendor offered by mstack-vendors (claude, or a fallback review), integrating accepted lanes, and delivering one pull request with serialized CI. Runs in Codex only.
